functions.name: create-subscription-line

key.description: Custom-attribute name; keys must be unique within this request.

value.description: Ordinary attribute text, including Unicode or an empty string.

items.description: One initial custom attribute on the new subscription line.

customAttributes.description: Initial contract/order-line attributes; one or more entries, with distinct keys. Empty values are allowed but null entries are not.

FunctionInput_prive_createsubscriptionli.description: Create one subscription line with initial attributes and optional price and delivery cadence.

id.description: Prive identifier of the newly created subscription line.

quantity.description: Quantity reported by the create response.

updatedAt.description: Creation response's line update instant normalized to UTC; a later attribute step may update it further.

tags.instructions: Use this to add a new line, not to change an existing one. Obtain the parent subscription's Prive ID, the variant's Prive ID, and the Shopify selling-plan ID from the subscription and catalog data. At least one initial custom attribute is required by this contract. Use `list-subscription-lines` to inspect existing lines. Creating a line can affect future subscription orders. Do not blindly retry after an uncertain result; check the subscription lines first. Use `update-subscription-line-custom-attributes` for subsequent attribute changes.

functions.name: create-subscription-line-schedule
functions.description: Create an order-relative delivery cadence for an existing subscription line.

deliveryInterval.description: Include this line every Nth delivery; 1 every delivery, 2 every other delivery, and so on.

FunctionInput_prive_createsubscriptionli.description: The existing subscription line and its order-relative delivery cadence.

id.description: Prive identifier of the new schedule when returned.

createdAt.description: Schedule creation instant in UTC when returned.

updatedAt.description: Schedule update instant in UTC when returned.

lastIncludedAt.description: Last-inclusion instant in UTC, mapped from lastIncludedDate when supplied.

FunctionOutput_prive_createsubscriptionl.description: The target subscription line and the schedule fields confirmed by Prive.

tags.instructions: Inspect `list-subscription-lines` and obtain the Prive line ID before calling. Use this when the line needs a new schedule; use `update-subscription-line-schedule` when changing an existing schedule. Cadence is measured in subscription deliveries and skipped orders, not calendar days or a timezone. Defaults include every delivery with no initial skipped orders. A line's schedule affects future inclusion; do not blindly repeat an uncertain create.

tags.instructions: Obtain subscriberId from `list-subscribers`. Supply only fields to change; null clears a nullable field, while omission preserves it. Use `get-subscriber` to inspect the current record. This can overwrite customer details and is not an atomic compare-and-set.

functions.name: update-subscription-cadence
functions.description: Update a subscription's billing and delivery cadences and matching line cadences. Lines without matching cadences are left unchanged by Prive.

billingCadenceCount.description: Desired positive number of units between billings.

deliveryCadenceCount.description: Desired positive number of units between deliveries.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionca.description: Subscription identifier and the complete desired billing and delivery cadence tuple.

billingCadenceCount.description: Resulting number of units between billings.

deliveryCadenceCount.description: Resulting number of units between deliveries.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptionc.description: Resulting subscription billing and delivery cadences returned by Prive.

tags.instructions: Use `get-subscription-cadence-update-preview` first to inspect available choices. This changes the subscription contract and may alter line offer options or pricing. Read `get-subscription` afterward when you need all resulting line details.

functions.name: update-subscription-custom-attributes
functions.description: Merge or replace subscription custom attributes, with an explicit choice to retain or discard unmentioned keys.

mode.description: Merge updates supplied keys while retaining others; replace overwrites the entire attribute list.

key.description: Exact attribute key used to match an existing attribute.

value.description: New ordinary Unicode value; empty text is a value, not deletion.

items.description: One subscription custom attribute key/value pair.

customAttributes.description: Attribute key/value pairs; empty list clears all only in replace mode. Keys must be unique within this input.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptioncu.description: Subscription custom attributes to merge by default or replace explicitly.

id.description: Prive subscription identifier that was updated.

updated.description: Provider acknowledged the attribute update; not an echoed resulting attribute list.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptionc.description: Acknowledgment of a subscription custom attribute update.

tags.instructions: Use a subscription ID from `get-subscription`. Merge is the safe default for retaining unmentioned keys. Replace removes existing attributes not included in your list; replace with an empty list clears all attributes.

functions.name: update-subscription-delivery-address
functions.description: Replace the editable delivery address and contact fields of a subscription.

zip.description: Postal code as text, including leading zeros.

address2.description: Additional street address; omission defaults to empty text to clear it.

province.description: Province or region name; empty text may represent not applicable if provider accepts it.

deliveryAddress.description: Complete replacement of editable delivery contact and address fields; company is not editable here.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionde.description: Subscription identifier and complete editable delivery address to replace.

shippingPrice.description: Resulting shipping price in contract currency units, or null.

shippingOption.description: Resulting shipping option when returned, or null.

company.description: Provider-returned delivery company, not changed by this tool.

deliveryAddress.description: Resulting delivery contact and address, preserving null fields.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptiond.description: Updated subscription delivery address and resulting shipping details.

tags.instructions: Use `get-subscription` to obtain the subscription ID and current address. Supply a complete editable address; omitted address2 is deliberately cleared. This does not edit the subscriber's identity or billing address.

functions.name: update-subscription-line-custom-attributes
functions.description: Merge custom attributes into a subscription line or replace its complete attribute set, including clearing it.

mode.description: Merge retains unspecified keys; replace overwrites the complete set. Default merge avoids accidental removal.

key.description: Attribute key to match or store without case normalization.

value.description: Ordinary text value, including Unicode and empty strings; an empty string is not a deletion marker.

items.description: A custom attribute key and its text value.

customAttributes.description: Attribute entries to merge or replace. Keys must be distinct. An empty replace array clears all attributes; an empty merge makes no attribute changes.

subscriptionLineId.description: Prive identifier of the subscription line whose attributes should change.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionli.description: The subscription line and custom attributes to merge or replace.

id.description: Prive identifier of the line whose attribute update succeeded.

updated.description: True when the provider acknowledged the requested attribute operation; does not contain a refreshed snapshot.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptionl.description: Acknowledgement of the subscription line custom attribute update, without a refreshed line snapshot.

tags.instructions: Get the Prive line ID from `list-subscription-lines`. Use merge to change selected keys while retaining other attributes; use replace to send the complete desired set. Replace with an empty array clears all attributes. This changes line metadata, not catalog product metadata. The result is an acknowledgement, not a fresh line snapshot; inspect `list-subscription-lines` if you need current values.

functions.name: update-subscription-line-price
functions.description: Replace the current price value of an existing subscription line.

subscriptionLineId.description: Prive identifier of the subscription line to reprice.

currentPrice.description: Replacement currentPrice in the provider's native price units; do not pre-scale relative to values returned by Prive. Null cannot reset the price.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionli.description: Subscription line identifier and replacement price in Prive-native units.

id.description: Prive identifier of the updated line.

subscriptionId.description: Prive identifier of the parent subscription.

currentPrice.description: Current line price returned by Prive, without scaling or currency inference.

quantity.description: Line quantity returned in the updated resource.

updatedAt.description: Updated line timestamp normalized to UTC without fractional precision loss.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptionl.description: Resulting subscription line price, quantity, parent subscription, and UTC update timestamp.

tags.instructions: Get the Prive line ID and inspect its current price using `list-subscription-lines`. Use this to change the line's price, not the catalog variant's default price. Supply the merchant's Prive-native price value; currency and denomination are not inferred. Use `update-subscription-line-quantity` for quantity changes. This can affect future subscription charges; inspect the result before replaying an uncertain write.

functions.name: update-subscription-line-quantity
functions.description: Replace the quantity on an existing subscription line with a value of at least one.

quantity.description: Replacement quantity, not a delta. At least one; sent without rounding. Null is not a clear operation.

subscriptionLineId.description: Prive identifier of the subscription line to change.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionli.description: Assign a replacement quantity to an existing Prive subscription line.

id.description: Prive identifier of the updated line.

quantity.description: Resulting line quantity returned by Prive.

updatedAt.description: Line update instant normalized to UTC without fractional precision loss.

currentPrice.description: Line currentPrice returned by Prive in unchanged native price units.

subscriptionId.description: Prive identifier of the parent subscription.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptionl.description: Updated subscription line summary returned by Prive, with its update instant normalized to UTC.

tags.instructions: Use the Prive line ID from `list-subscription-lines`. This assigns the new quantity rather than adding a delta, and can affect future subscription charges and deliveries. Quantity must be at least one. To remove a line entirely, use `delete-subscription-line`, not quantity zero. Check current state before replaying an uncertain write.

functions.name: update-subscription-line-schedule
functions.description: Replace the delivery interval and initial skipped-order offset on an existing subscription-line schedule.

subscriptionLineId.description: Prive identifier of the line whose existing schedule should change.

deliveryInterval.description: Complete replacement every-N-deliveries multiplier; 1 means every delivery.

deliveryStartOffset.description: Complete replacement count of orders to skip before the cadence starts; zero removes an initial offset.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionli.description: The subscription line and both desired replacement cadence settings.

subscriptionLineId.description: Prive identifier of the line whose schedule was updated.

createdAt.description: Schedule creation instant in UTC, when supplied.

updatedAt.description: Schedule update instant in UTC, when supplied.

lastIncludedAt.description: Last-inclusion instant in UTC, mapped from lastIncludedDate.

lastIncludedOrderNumber.description: Provider-reported last included order number, when available.

schedule.description: Actual schedule fields returned by Prive; missing source fields remain omitted.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptionl.description: The updated line identifier and actual schedule fields returned by Prive.

tags.instructions: Inspect `list-subscription-lines` to obtain the line ID and current cadence. Supply both desired cadence settings, carrying forward any value you want to retain. This replaces the two configurable settings; it is not a date-based schedule or a partial patch. Use `create-subscription-line-schedule` when no schedule exists. Changing the cadence can affect future inclusion in subscription orders; do not assume it resets historical order counters.

functions.name: update-subscription-line-variant
functions.description: Replace a subscription line's product variant, optionally selecting a different subscription-offer option.

variantId.description: Prive identifier of the replacement product variant, not its Shopify external ID.

subscriptionLineId.description: Prive identifier of the existing subscription line to swap.

subscriptionOfferOptionId.description: Optional Prive subscription-offer-option ID to apply. Omission delegates plan behavior to Prive; null does not clear the option.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionli.description: Subscription line and replacement Prive variant, with an optional Prive offer option.

id.description: Prive line identifier returned after the swap; use this returned identity for subsequent work.

quantity.description: Line quantity returned after the swap.

updatedAt.description: Resulting line update instant normalized to UTC without precision loss.

variantId.description: Prive identifier of the variant returned after the swap.

currentPrice.description: Resulting line price in unchanged native provider price units.

variantTitle.description: Display title of the resulting variant, preserving Unicode.

sellingPlanId.description: Resulting Shopify selling-plan ID, or null when unset.

subscriptionId.description: Prive identifier of the parent subscription.

variantExternalId.description: Shopify identifier of the resulting variant, retained as an opaque string.

subscriptionOfferOptionId.description: Resulting Prive offer-option ID, or null when unset.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptionl.description: Actual resulting subscription line, including its variant, price, quantity, and plan references.

tags.instructions: Get the Prive line ID from `list-subscription-lines` and the replacement variant's Prive ID from catalog data. An optional offer-option ID is a Prive ID, not a Shopify selling-plan ID. Use this to replace a line's product rather than deleting and recreating the line. A swap may change pricing or plan selection; inspect the returned values. Omission of the offer option delegates its selection to Prive. Do not assume unchanged prices or safe replay.

functions.name: update-subscription-next-billing-and-delivery-dates
functions.description: Reschedule a subscription's next billing and delivery instants, optionally recording a pause-related change and an anchor value.

isPause.description: Whether this rescheduling is because of a pause; true causes Prive to append additional subscription custom attributes.

nextBillingDate.description: Desired next billing instant with explicit UTC marker or numeric offset; millisecond precision maximum.

nextDeliveryDate.description: Desired next delivery instant with explicit offset; millisecond precision maximum.

anchoredNextBillingDate.description: Optional provider anchor instant; Prive describes this as the anchor date of the next delivery date despite its billing-oriented name. Millisecond precision maximum; omission does not request clearing.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionne.description: Subscription and paired billing and delivery instants to reschedule, with optional pause context and anchor.

nextBillingDate.description: Resulting next billing instant in UTC, or null.

nextDeliveryDate.description: Resulting next delivery instant in UTC, or null.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptionn.description: Updated subscription identifier and resulting UTC billing and delivery instants returned by Prive.

tags.instructions: Read `get-subscription` before rescheduling. Both next billing and delivery dates are required and change together. A pause-related change appends subscription attributes; it is not a substitute for changing the subscription status.

functions.name: update-subscription-offer-option
functions.description: Select a Prive offer option for an existing subscription.

subscriptionOfferOptionId.description: Prive subscription offer option identifier, not a Shopify selling plan ID.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionof.description: Select a Prive offer option for an existing subscription.

subscriptionOfferOptionId.description: Resulting Prive offer option identifier, or null.

sellingPlanId.description: Resulting Shopify selling plan identifier, or null.

currentPrice.description: Resulting line current price in provider units, without scaling.

items.description: Observed option and price assignment for one subscription line.

lines.description: Resulting line option and price assignments, not assumed uniformly equal to the requested option.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptiono.description: Observed subscription cadences and per-line assignments after selecting the offer option.

tags.instructions: Get the subscription from `get-subscription` and an eligible Prive offer option ID from product offer options in `list-products` or `list-swap-and-add-on-options`. Do not pass a Shopify selling plan ID in place of the Prive option ID. This can change commercial cadence or pricing.

functions.name: update-subscription-payment-method
functions.description: Select an existing Shopify payment method for a subscription.

paymentMethodExternalId.description: Existing Shopify payment method identifier eligible for this subscription's subscriber; never null.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionpa.description: Subscription and existing Shopify payment method to select.

paymentMethodExternalId.description: Resulting Shopify payment method identifier returned by Prive.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptionp.description: Subscription payment method state returned by Prive after the update.

tags.instructions: Obtain an eligible Shopify payment method ID for the subscriber with `list-subscriber-shopify-payment-methods`. This replaces the subscription's selected funding method. To ask the subscriber to reset their details by email, use `send-subscription-payment-method-update-email` instead.

functions.name: update-subscription-shipping-option
functions.description: Change a subscription's shipping option and fixed shipping price in its contract currency.

shippingPrice.description: Fixed shipping price in contract currency units, for example 49.99, not cents.

shippingOptionCode.description: Merchant shipping option code to select.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionsh.description: Subscription and the fixed shipping option and price to set together.

shippingPrice.description: Resulting shipping price in contract currency units, or null.

shippingOption.description: Provider-returned shipping option, or null; not necessarily the input code.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptions.description: Resulting subscription shipping option and fixed price returned by Prive.

tags.instructions: Get the subscription and currency using `get-subscription`. Obtain the shipping option code from the merchant's shipping configuration; this API does not list codes. Supply the fixed shipping price, not a minor-unit amount.

functions.name: update-subscription-status
functions.description: Change a subscription to an explicit lifecycle status, including pausing, activating, cancelling, expiring or marking it failed.

status.description: Requested lifecycle status; explicit selection is required and no ACTIVE default is applied.

cancelReason.description: Cancellation reason text, allowed only when status is CANCELLED; omission supplies no reason, empty text is sent explicitly.

FunctionInput_prive_updatesubscriptionst.description: The subscription and explicit lifecycle status to write, with an optional cancellation-only reason.

cancelDate.description: Cancellation instant in UTC, or null.

cancelReason.description: Resulting recorded cancellation reason, or null.

pausedAtDate.description: Pause instant in UTC, or null.

FunctionOutput_prive_updatesubscriptions.description: The resulting subscription lifecycle state and cancellation or pause details, with instants normalized to UTC.

tags.instructions: Read `get-subscription` before changing status. CANCELLED changes subscription lifecycle, not record identity or past orders; PAUSED is a pause, not deletion. Provide a cancellation reason only for CANCELLED. Transitions and reversibility remain subject to Prive's current rules.

functions.name: update-upcoming-order-skip-status
functions.description: Skip or unskip a projected upcoming subscription order. Merchant automations can also affect other upcoming orders.

subscriptionId.description: Prive subscription identifier containing the upcoming order.

scheduledDate.description: Exact scheduled instant of the projected order from get-subscription; explicit offset required and fractional precision preserved.

isSkipped.description: True skips the projected order; false unskips it.

FunctionInput_prive_updateupcomingorders.description: Subscription, exact upcoming order schedule, and desired skip status.

subscriptionId.description: Prive subscription identifier containing the order.

scheduledDate.description: Provider-returned scheduled order instant in UTC.

isSkipped.description: Resulting skip status returned by Prive.

FunctionOutput_prive_updateupcomingorder.description: Reported skip status and UTC schedule of the selected upcoming order.

tags.instructions: Use `get-subscription` to get the subscription ID and exact upcomingOrders scheduledDate. Set isSkipped true to skip and false to unskip. This affects a projected upcoming order, not a placed order; inspect the subscription afterward because automations may alter other upcoming orders.
